Vaihāyamantrakośa
q. in Siṃhasiddhāntasindhu of Śivānanda, see Ujjain Latest Additions 177.

Vaihāyasasaṃhitā
q. in Gītātātparyanirṇaya of Madhva. See B. N. K. Sharma, His.. of Dvai. Lit. p. 92.

Vaihāyasa
based on Pāñcarātrāgama. One of the Āgamas consulted by the a. of Prayogapaddhati or Ratnāvali,

Vaihāyasatantra
q. in Pādmatantra or Pādmasaṃhitā of Nāradapāñcarātra,

Vaihāyasapañcarātra
q. in Siṃhasiddhāntasindhu of Śivānanda. See Ujjain Latest Additions 176.
